decisions.proposed_text: Từ nay về sau, hãy tiếp tục gánh vác trách nhiệm của một Trainer,\nvà chân thành đồng hành cùng Mã Nương bằng tất cả nhiệt huyết.
decisions.reason: Generic 训练员 and 赛马娘 use the project player-facing terms Trainer and Mã Nương; the rest of the sentence is faithful and natural.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded community terms common.trainer and common.world.umamusume require Trainer and Mã Nương and explicitly forbid Huấn luyện viên and Uma Musume here.

decisions.reason: Here 速度 is part of ordinary prose 成长速度 (growth rate/speed), not the gameplay Speed stat. The embedded community matcher overmatches this lexical context, so a canonical context rule is needed before resolving the item.

canonical_finding.concept: Generic 速度 inside lexical compounds or prose must not be forced to the Speed stat label
canonical_finding.reason: 成长速度 means growth speed/rate in prose; replacing Tốc độ with the gameplay label Speed would be a false positive from an overly broad alias.

decisions.proposed_text: Đại diện cho giới đua ngựa\nchính là cặp Mã Nương và Trainer này nhỉ!
decisions.reason: The sentence meaning is already correct, but both generic project terms are noncanonical in the current Vietnamese.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.world.umamusume requires Mã Nương for generic 赛马娘 and common.trainer requires Trainer for 训练员.

decisions.reason: Vô Thanh Vô Tì is a concise, faithful Sino-Vietnamese rendering of 无声无瑕 and preserves the title-like structure.

The item is explicitly blocked by open canonical finding cf-d1bcaa0ab582cbdf: 宝石 must not overmatch gemstone compounds such as 绿宝石 as the Jewel currency. The current lexical gemstone rendering is plausible, but the canonical context must resolve first.
